actions.name: get_website_stats
actions.description: Returns a summary of visitors, pageviews, bounce rate, and average visit duration for a date range.

actions.name: get_website_metrics
actions.description: Returns a ranked list for a chosen metric category (e.g. top pages, browsers, or countries) over a date range.

actions.name: get_active_visitors
actions.description: Returns the number of people currently browsing a website in real time.

actions.name: get_pageviews
actions.description: Returns pageview and session counts over time, broken down by hour, day, week, month, or year.

actions.name: send_event
actions.description: Records a custom event or pageview on a website. Leave the event name blank to track a plain pageview.

actions.name: list_websites
actions.description: Returns all websites tracked in your Umami account.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_event
triggers.description: Triggers when a new custom event is recorded on a website.

triggers.name: new_session
triggers.description: Triggers when a new visitor session is detected on a website.
